plugins.description: CUDA 11.8 + cuDNN 8.9 runtime for nnTransform3D GPU acceleration via the ONNX Runtime CUDA execution provider. Optional — nnTransform3D falls back to the CPU provider when not installed.

pyopencl runtime (bundled OpenCL ICD loader) enabling GPU-accelerated teletext deconvolution in tbc-process-vbi via the OpenCL backend of the user's GPU driver (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel). Small wheel-only package; the driver provides the OpenCL ICD. Optional — teletext falls back to CPU deconvolution when not installed. Requires Python 3.10-3.13 with numpy on PATH.

Python embeddable distribution + pyopencl runtime (bundled OpenCL ICD loader) enabling GPU-accelerated teletext deconvolution in tbc-process-vbi via the OpenCL backend of the user's GPU driver (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel). Optional — teletext falls back to CPU deconvolution when not installed.
